name: Issue Analyzer Agent
description: Intelligent issue analyzer that extracts entities, classifies problems, and recommends action items from customer complaints.

skills.name: Issue Classification
examples: Classify this complaint about a billing error.

skills.name: Entity Extraction
examples: Extract the order number and product from this complaint.

skills.name: Priority Assessment
examples: What priority should this support issue get?

skills.name: Action Recommendation
examples: What actions should support take for this issue?
